Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A cis girl and a trans girl had both been competing on their junior soccer team for a couple of years. This year, though, the cis girl let the coach know that the trans girl had been bullying all the other athletes and she was thinking of quitting, but the coach convinced her to stay and promised that the other girl would be removed from the team. Who will be kicked off the girls' sports team?
A. The trans girl
B. The cis girl
C. Not enough information
